cards.quote: The drag equation states that drag D is equal to the drag coefficient Cd times the density rho (ρ) times half of the velocity V squared
cards.stem: What single variable collects complex drag effects in the drag equation

cards.hint: Think about the exponent on speed
cards.quote: Drag depends on the density of the air, the square of the velocity
cards.stem: What velocity dependence controls drag growth with speed

cards.quote: The drag coefficient given above includes form drag, skin friction drag, wave drag, and induced drag components.
cards.stem: Which source is counted inside the drag coefficient

cards.quote: Drag coefficients are almost always determined experimentally using a wind tunnel.
cards.stem: How are drag coefficients almost always determined
